function.name: supervisor__complete_task
function.description: Mark the currently active task as complete with the given answer.

answer.description: The answer to the task instruction. Pass it if and only if the task requests an answer, e.g., 'How many songs are in the Spotify queue?'. The answer must be concise, such as a number, a yes/no, or a specific entity, name, etc, e.g., '10' in this case. If the task is not a question, e.g., 'Start my Spotify music player.', the answer must be left to the default value, i.e., None.
